technique_name: Write a paragraph using the words "perspective", "integrity" and "diversity".
description: Different perspectives add to the integrity of a society that values diversity. Everyone should be able to express themselves and their thoughts freely, as this allows us to gain a much larger perspective on the world. This helps to ensure that our conversations and decisions always contain honesty and integrity.
